Package edu.scu.phantommaze.model

Class Combo

java.lang.Object
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Combo
public class Combo extends Object
Counts a kill streak during a power-up. Each kill must come within Config.COMBO_WINDOW seconds of the one before, and only different enemies count, so the same enemy killed twice after respawning does not help. When every enemy has been killed in one streak, the combo is complete and rampage mode starts.
